name: story-logbook-1
notes: Story panels between and after the rooms.

slots.subject: An old open logbook on a wooden workbench, handwritten neat lines of sums on the page; one line is written slightly differently and a pencil has been set down right beside it. A small brass lamp lights the page. Nobody in the picture, no hands.
slots.camera: Close view from above at a slight angle.
slots.composition: The open logbook in the centre, large.
